description: a grand Ghaznavid capital skyline at dawn, minarets and mudbrick towers rising from a fortified hill city, wide establishing view
a busy caravan road stretching to the horizon, merchants and pack animals of many peoples, mountains in the distance
an imperial palace courtyard, empty throne dais visible through an archway, guards standing at a respectful distance
a remote frontier watchtower on a dusty ridge, a thinned patrol passing below, the land beyond looking unwatched
a modest merchant's shopfront in a capital bazaar, awnings and stacked goods, ordinary daily commerce
a merchant's hand closing a ledger book on a wooden counter, a lamp burning low, a folded paper tucked half-hidden beneath it
Turkmen horsemen gathering on an open steppe at dusk, a line of riders silhouetted against the sky
a chaotic skirmish at a frontier garrison wall, soldiers fighting in disarray, horsemen riding off in the background with sacks and bundles of plunder
a caravan crossing open desert at speed, a lone rider peeling off from the group toward the horizon
a capital city street at dusk, shops closing their shutters, lamplight beginning to show in windows, ordinary and calm
a quiet merchant's shopfront interior at evening, a single lamp lit, an empty stool beside a stacked ledger
